analysis.title: GS Milhous - Mark to Market for Wednesday 14 Oct 2026
key_insights: US equities fell on 14 Oct after a hotter than expected CPI print. SPX -111bps to 7718, NDX -202bps to 29,950, RTY -193bps to 2729. It was the S&P's first -1% move in 53 days, and breadth was negative.
Core CPI printed 33bps unrounded against consensus of 20bps, with firmer shelter, auto and lodging categories. Markets now price rate hike probabilities of 35% for October and 87% for December.
8 of 11 sectors finished lower. Tech fell 2.62% and Communication Services fell 1.73%. Healthcare (+2.44%), Consumer Staples (+2.38%) and Energy (+0.80%) outperformed in a rotation into defensives.
GS custom baskets showed the rotation: Global NeoClouds (GSXGNEOC) -10.93%, GS Quantum Computing index (GSX1QNT1) -7.14%, Expensive Defensive (GSXUEDEF) +1.18%.

Rates were choppy, with volumes about 140% above recent averages and the curve flatter. 2y notes moved in a 20bp range and closed essentially flat. The rest of the curve traded a range of more than 10bp. 2s10s cash is about 3bps flatter and 2s30s about 4.5bps flatter.

After the CPI print, 2y notes sold off 20bps and the Oct FOMC priced a high of 14bps of hikes. As risk fell, price action turned to growth fears and a flight to quality into USTs. The market closed pricing about 8.5bps of hikes for October and about 30bps through year-end. FM and RM were better buyers of USTs across the curve.
In swaps, steepening and paying of rate helped back-end swap spreads trade well.

Macro credit widened the most in a single session in months and underperformed stocks. CDX IG closed +1.86bp wider and CDX HY closed 43cts lower. The AI trade is under pressure among the repeat funders.

ORCL CDS closed +31bps wider. CRWV bonds fell another 2pts and ASUCOR another 3pts. CCC and high beta BB names continue to weaken in LevFin. IG cash closed 1-2bps wider, with hypers (+4-5bps) and datacenters (+7bps) underperforming. HY cash closed about 0.5pt lower, with HY AI datacenters lagging on the CRWV move.
Primary issuance was light: $3.8bn priced in 2 IG deals and $0.9bn in 1 HY deal.

The dollar rose across G10 after the CPI print. EUR closed -40bps lower and has taken out and stayed below key support at 1.1190/1.1200. GS sees the path of least resistance lower into 1.1000, and notes that a US cooldown may not arrive in time for Europe.

Spot-vol correlation is starting to underperform. Recent sessions showed spot down/vol down moves as investors unwound EUR puts rather than add fresh risk. JPY and NOK were the best G10 performers and ended about flat. With 50-50 market odds for an October hike, G10 FX pairs price a roughly 50bps implied gap for the next FOMC meeting.
